Definition: from G5011; to depress; figuratively, to humiliate (in condition or heart):--abase, bring low, humble (self).
BiblicalUsage: Jesus says it twice over: whosoever shall exalt himself shall be abased, and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted. Christ humbled Himself and became obedient unto death, even the death of the cross. Peter and James both give the same command, humble yourselves under the mighty hand of God, and He will lift you up.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe humbling is not thinking little of yourself but putting yourself under God's hand, and the Lord who went lowest is the one who lifts the lowly. My position is that the way up in the kingdom is down, and God keeps His promise to exalt the humble in due time.
